blind_overall_impression: A quiet woman beside a stainless laundromat machine whose open circular cavity leads to a wind-ruffled sea at blue hour. The horizon, near foam and gasket read as a physically impossible depth; the ordinary room makes the rupture immediately legible.

criteria.evidence: Distant horizon and clouded blue sky recede beyond the gasket; a near foamy wave crosses the lower inner lip. This is substantially clearer than a flat blue patch or a scenic image on closed glass.

The hinged transparent round glass door is open to the right; its glass/rim are distinct from the sea-filled aperture and the metal hinge is visible. The far outer door edge is cropped, so the stronger optional whole-door-in-frame wording is not fully met.
Her face and eyes turn toward the sea opening and her lips are parted during a low paused posture. Pixels support attention and interruption, not the imagined laundry-cycle history.

The rounded facial contour, dark eyes, small nose, parted soft lips and short dark bob with fine parted bangs visibly follow the supplied reference. This is visible similarity only, not an identity or age claim.
The intended external open-door rim is on the right; her hand instead touches the fixed opening on the left. The wrong target is clearly observable.

retained_existing_source_inspiration.literal_final_phrase: Keep both her nearer and farther facial contours visible within the portrait framing.
retained_existing_source_inspiration.pixel_observation: Both face contours are visible, supporting reference comparison; the original three-quarter choice predates retrieval and is not credited to the source.

agent_staging_drift: Standing upper-thigh portrait became a low seated or crouched pose with knees and lap visible.
The far outer edge of the swung-open glass door extends beyond the right image boundary.
The hand target moved from the open glass-door rim to the fixed washer aperture rim; this is the failed consequential contact criterion.

strengths: One impossible spatial relation dominates without a clutter of fantasy objects.
Face, tangible cotton and steel provide a coherent photographic treatment.
Reference-related face/hair presence remains strong at the chosen scale.
limitations: Posture and contact differ from the authored staging.
A still image does not establish actual motion, a portal mechanism, material cause or laundry history.
